messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas closing my eyes and wondering why chocolate was so secretive.

output.original_text: I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas closing my eyes and wondering why chocolate was so secretive.
output.joy: I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas, eyes closed, filled with excitement as I wondered why chocolate was so secretive!
output.sadness: I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas, closing my eyes and feeling a little lonely as I wondered why chocolate was so secretive.
output.fear: I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas, closing my eyes, feeling a shiver as I wondered why chocolate was so secretive.
output.anger: I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas, closing my eyes and feeling frustrated while wondering why chocolate was so secretive!
output.surprise: I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas, eyes closed, taken aback as I wondered why chocolate was so secretive!
output.disgust: I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas, closing my eyes and grimacing as I wondered why chocolate had to be so secretive.
